videos.headline: Jadeja to Lees, out Lees Run Out!! Two in two overs. Kohli is going berserk. India fans in the crowd erupt and the match has turned on its head. Root has sold Lees down the river there. Flighted outside off, Lees lunges forward and attempts to push it into the off-side, the ball turns in and squirts off the inside edge to short fine, Root kept running for the single and Lees was late to react, Shami collects the ball and throws to Jadeja, Lees is not even in the frame. He was not sure where the ball was and that didn't help. A good knock from the left hander but England needed more than just 56. Lees run out (Shami/Jadeja) 56(65) [4s-8]

Bumrah to Ollie Pope, out Caught by Pant!! Bumrah, you beauty! If England got off to a perfect start, Bumrah has given India the perfect start to the session. Pope goes back without troubling the scorers. The Indians are pumped and so is their skipper. Back of a length delivery angled in and holds its line, Pope plays for the angle, he stays back and has a nibble, faintest of outside edges and Pant does the rest. Ollie Pope c Pant b Bumrah 0(3)

Bumrah to Crawley, out Bowled!! Left alone. The changed ball has brought India luck. Crawley, after playing so well, misjudges one completely. He shuffles across, leaves assuming the line to stay outside off, but it nips in just a slight bit and pegs the top of off. Crawley b Bumrah 46(76) [4s-7]

Stokes to Jadeja, out Bowled!! Chopped on! He could have played a few shots, instead of this approach. Rather than taking singles off the fourth ball of every over, playing a few shots might have helped stretch that lead to the 400-run mark. Never got going in things did Jadeja. Anyway, was a short of a length delivery that shaped back in sharply and Jadeja attempted a cut, and he has chopped it on. Stokes has both the wickets after lunch! Only one wicket away from cleaning up the tail. Jadeja b Stokes 23(58) [4s-1]

Jack Leach to Pant, out Caught by Root!! Leach lost the battle to Pant in the first innings and has won it in the second. India are gifting wickets away; first Pujara, then Iyer and now Pant. He goes for the reverse sweep but the spin cramps him up, the ball hits the top of the bat and lobs to Root at slip, he's attentive and hangs on to a sharp catch. India not out of the woods yet as the lead is just 330. Pant c Root b Jack Leach 57(86) [4s-8]

Matty Potts to Shreyas Iyer, out Caught by Anderson!! The strategy was for everybody to see. The trap was for everybody to see. Three men out catching for a false shot to a short ball, and Iyer walks into it. The ball's around head-high, and takes his eyes off the ball as he goes through with yet-another compulsive pull, ending up getting it straight and flat to mid-wicket. He in fact was trying to keep it down, and it clearly didn't work. England can sense an opening here .. Shreyas Iyer c Anderson b Matty Potts 19(26) [4s-3]

Broad to Pujara, out Caught by Lees!! And all it needed was a real nothing delivery to end Pujara's vigil -- short, wide, sitting up. Pujara lays into it with a flashy cut, but gets it straight to backward point, who does well to reverse-cup it in front of his face. Pujara c Lees b Broad 66(168) [4s-8]

Stokes to Kohli, out Caught by Root!! A snake of a delivery, kicking up off nowhere as Kohli presses in front to defend, with the ball popping up off the glove to the keeper. Billings drops, but Root - first slip - is alert enough to the possibility of lapping up the ricochet. This one's not a case of Virat in bad form, it's just a case of Virat and his rotten luck. Kohli c Root b Stokes 20(40) [4s-4]

Broad to Hanuma Vihari, out Caught by Bairstow!! Loose drive this -- chasing a wide-full delivery outside off exactly the way England would've wanted him to. He's walked right into the trap. His stride isn't big, and he's just not close enough as goes through a big booming cover drive away from his body. Ends up outside-edging it straight down third slip's throat. Hanuma Vihari c Bairstow b Broad 11(44) [4s-1]

Anderson to Shubman Gill, out Caught by Crawley!! Anderson strikes in his first over! And how often have we seen that? Short of a length delivery around off and Gill wants to play at it. Gets a thick outside edge that flies to second slip and Crawley completes a safe catch in the cordon. Anderson is pumped up and so are his team mates and the England supporters in the stands. Shubman Gill c Crawley b Anderson 4(3) [4s-1]

Siraj to Billings, out Bowled!! Dragged on! Siraj has his third wicket and India need one more. Wobble seam delivery that shapes back in, Billings was aiming to steer it to third man but the movement cramped him, the ball takes the inside edge and rattles the stumps. Billings b Siraj 36(57) [4s-4]

Shami to Bairstow, out Caught by Kohli!! Like I said something is going to give and luckily for India it is the big wicket of Bairstow. He walks off to a standing ovation and raises his bat to acknowledge that. A fine knock comes to an end. The last few overs were quiet and Bairstow could not resist from playing the booming drive. Full delivery well outside off, Bairstow goes hard on the shot and the outside edge flies to Kohli at first slip, he takes a sharp catch with his fingers pointing up. Bairstow c Kohli b Shami 106(140) [4s-14 6s-2]

Thakur to Stokes, out Caught by Bumrah!! Shardul has the last laugh! India have finally managed to hold on to one catch. Was slapped hard by Stokes again, but Bumrah manages to take a sharp catch this time around. Was dropped twice was the England captain, but he finally runs out of luck. Stokes c Bumrah b Thakur 25(36) [4s-4]

Shami to Jack Leach, out Caught by Pant!! Leach in his grand stay of five balls, was dropped, survived an edge that fell short, and now has nicked off. Shami finally has his share of luck in the wickets column for what has technically been a non-stop spell of 13 overs, and he does it with a typically seam-up delivery in the corridor just outside off, which is too good for Leach to not poke at, only to end up with a faint outside-edge through to the keeper. Jack Leach c Pant b Shami 0(5)

Siraj to Root, out Caught by Pant!! Here's the most prized wicket of the day. A short of a length delivery outside off, and it shapes back in a long way. Root looks to cut this through the off-side, ends up getting cramped and an under-edges it. Pant completes the formalities behind the wicket and like I said before, England's ace batter is gone. Siraj strikes only in his second over of the day. With 7 overs remaining in the day, India wouldn't mind getting a wicket or two before stumps. Root c Pant b Siraj 31(67) [4s-4]

Bumrah to Ollie Pope, out Caught by Shreyas Iyer!! That extra delivery of the over -- it sucked in Crawley, and it sucks Pope in. Full, outside off, tempting out a big booming cover drive, and gets just that, with a healthy outside-edge flying to the right of Iyer at wide second slip, who juggles, and then takes the rebound off his chest. Ollie Pope c Shreyas Iyer b Bumrah 10(18) [4s-2]

Bumrah to Crawley, out Caught by Shubman Gill!! There's that loose drive, and there's that big fat outside-edge. Bumrah - with one ball on either side of the break - is suddenly on a hat-trick. Oh as if that Broad smacking wasn't good enough to make this his day already! A pretty full delivery, sixth-stump line, and Crawley doesn't get to the pitch of it, but goes after it with hard hands, and it's a simple catch for third slip. Crawley c Shubman Gill b Bumrah 9(17) [4s-1]

Bumrah to Lees, out Bowled!! Knocked him over! Bumrah draws first blood! A lovely length ball directed at the stumps and Lees gets beaten in his defence. The ball sneaks through, takes a small deflection off the pad and rattles timber as the extra ball has resulted in a wicket. The Indian captain has a smile on his face as the fielders in the cordon celebrate in joy. Lees b Bumrah 6(9) [4s-1]

Anderson to Jadeja, out Bowled!! Cleaned up! A fine knock comes to an end and Jadeja walks off to a standing ovation. He raises his bat and acknowledges the applause. Full and the ball swings in the air, Jadeja goes for the heave across the line and misses it completely, the ball beats the inside edge and trims the top of middle-stump. Jadeja b Anderson 104(194) [4s-13]

Root to Pant, out Caught by Crawley!! England have bought Pant out here. They really should have turned to Root much earlier, who's done exactly what part-timers are meant to do with these massive partnerships and with batsman like Rishabh -- played to his ego. It's floated wide, outside off, almost forcing him to smash it out of the park. But he doesn't quite get to the pitch of it this time, swinging big and outside-edging it to slip. Nevertheless, this has been one crazy assault. In terms of audacity, box-office, and the sheer impact on match results, cricketing history will struggle to find a competitor to this 2021-22 version of Rishabh Pant .. Pant c Crawley b Root 146(111) [4s-20 6s-4]

Anderson to Shreyas Iyer, out Caught by Billings!! Tickled. Strangled down leg. A very un-Jimmy dismissal -- short, angling in around the ribs, and Iyer looks to glance, but gets beaten for pace, for bounce, and gets a very faint inside-edge that's flying to the left of Billings, who goes full goalkie-like, and grabs. Shreyas Iyer c Billings b Anderson 15(11) [4s-3]

Matty Potts to Kohli, out Bowled!! Dragged on. Half a forward defence, half a leave, and a full chop-on off the inside-edge to smash into the stumps. India are bleeding. And Kohli falls to his indecision. It's a sixth-stump line, swinging in. Kohli presses in front to perhaps defend it away, but then decides to shoulder arms, but does it late, with the ball ricocheting on. Kohli b Matty Potts 11(19) [4s-2]

Matty Potts to Hanuma Vihari, out Lbw!! Straight seam, pitched up, seaming in off the pitch, and Vihari's played down the wrong line entirely. Totally foxed. And totally plumb. He's struck bang in front of middle, under the knee roll, and Kohli rightly doesn't allow him to burn a review on it. Hanuma Vihari lbw b Matty Potts 20(53) [4s-1]

Anderson to Pujara, out Caught by Crawley!! Crawley makes no mistake. Anderson strikes again and this is a big blow for India. Pujara had looked solild in his stay but his undone by England's ace bowler. Good length ball around off, Pujara has to play because of the line and he is on the forward press, but the ball bounces more and takes the shoulder of the bat, carries at a nice height to second slip and Crawley hangs on. Things are starting to happen now as the lacquer on the Dukes ball is wearing off. Pujara c Crawley b Anderson 13(46) [4s-2]

Anderson to Shubman Gill, out Caught by Crawley!! Anderson inevitably strikes! Can't keep out the seasoned pro for long in these conditions. England's new-ball duo have been guilty of spraying it a touch too wide frequently, but this time, the line is perfect from Jimmy. Angling in closer to the off stump, gets it to shape away and the angle draws Gill into a hard-handed waft. Extra bounce and the edge is pouched comfortably at second slip. For all that talk about no carry, this went at a comfortable height. India lose their first. Shubman Gill c Crawley b Anderson 17(24) [4s-4]
